working_on.task: Dashboard Overhaul Complete - Fixed Layout Stabilized
working_on.notes: Layout is fully complete with 8px margin, 38px uniform controls, sticky table headers, and fixed pagination UI.

decisions_made.reason: Ensure visual consistency across all forms and filters in the Navbar area.
Applied sticky top-0 over .overflow-auto thead in tailwind.css for easy adoption across all list views without inline styling.
Prevents pagination from scrolling out of view when user is reading data logs.

recent_changes.description: Implemented global CSS rule for uniform 38px Navbar controls and sticky table headers.
Refactored all dashboard pages (rooms, bills, residents, contracts, tenants, users) to decouple pagination from scrollable table containers.
Committed and pushed complete UI overhaul changes to FE branch.
